messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Routing policy churn alert — p95-triggered reroutes firing rapidly between regions (us-east <-> ap-south) causing request thrash. Count=12 in last 7m. Paging oncall and SREs. root_ts=2245678901

sam_sre: ack. pulling routing audit and model rollout diffs. anyone seeing related deploys?

oncall-jay: i'm on. no infra deploys in last 30m. saw a model variant rollout to ap-south earlier today (fp16-large-canary). perf bench looked fine for median but p95 for long sequences was worse than prod baseline.

rina_sre: confirming. smart-routing policy has immediate reroute when p95 > 300ms. without cooldown this creates flip-flop when two regions alternately exceed threshold. also observed cache-warmup spikes after reroutes.

mina_mlops: fp16-large-canary was enabled for 20% traffic this morning. we used avg-latency gate for rollout, not tail metrics. bad call on our canary config.

taylor_pm: customers noticing slow UX and some gateway timeouts. CS reporting 3 escalations so far. we should put an interim customer message.

ops-ela: recommended quick fixes?

sam_sre: propose immediate triage steps:
- throttle reroute frequency (set min_interval=300s) to stop oscillation
- set policy to require 2 consecutive p95 windows before reroute (hysteresis)
- demote fp16-large-canary to standby (0%) in ap-south
- pin high-sensitivity routes to origin region until stable

oncall-jay: throttle change fastest. infra command below to set cooldown:

```
# set reroute cooldown to 300s
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  https://controlplane.internal/api/v1/routing/policies/latency_reroute \
  -d '{"cooldown_seconds":300}'
```

infra-ci: applying cooldown now. patch returned 200. cooldown_seconds=300.

incident-bot: action logged: cooldown applied by infra-ci (runbook: routing-throttle).

mina_mlops: demoting fp16-large-canary via rollout API now.

mina_mlops: demotion complete. ap-south pools back to stable fp16-large-base variant.

rina_sre: pinning high-sensitivity customer routes per ops list. command executed.

ops-ela: monitoring shows reroute pulses stopped within 1 minute. p95 trending down but ap-south tail still elevated from earlier canary traffic warming.

taylor_pm: sending short customer update: "We're aware of intermittent latency; we've applied mitigations and will follow up with root cause & timeline."

sam_sre: next steps for full remediation:
- add compatibility check: routing can only choose variants with certified_p95 <= threshold for current seq distribution
- add 2-window hysteresis and cooldown as defaults for p95 policies
- require canary gating on p95 for >1k long-seq synthetic requests before region rollout
- create reroute-churn alert (count > 3 in 10m) to page instead of auto-act

mina_mlops: will run a long-sequence traffic replay against fp16-large variant in staging and attach perf profiles.

infra-ci: filed INF-4902 for policy changes; assigned to sam_sre + rina_sre.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by on-call. Pager escalation paused while mitigations active.

incident-bot: automated summary:
- symptom: rapid p95-triggered reroutes between regions => increased tail latency & intermittent timeouts
- immediate cause: canary variant (fp16-large-canary) with degraded p95 for long prompts + routing policy without cooldown/hysteresis/compatibility guard
- mitigations applied: reroute cooldown=300s, demoted canary, pinned sensitive routes, customer comms sent
- impact: brief window with ~15% of requests seeing >2x p95; 3 escalations recorded; no data loss
- owner: sam_sre (follow-up/postmortem)

rina_sre: handing incident to sam for postmortem. i'll stay on thread for any infra questions.

sam_sre: taking ownership. immediate follow-ups assigned:
- mina_mlops: run replay + update canary gating (ETA 6h)
- rina_sre + infra: implement policy guards and reroute cooldown default (ETA 24h)
- ops-ela: add reroute-churn alert and runbook (ETA 12h)
- taylor_pm: coordinate customer postmortem note and CS debrief (ETA 48h)

ops-ela: monitoring note: no new escalations in last 20m; p95 near baseline. closing live paging. will reopen if churn resumes.

incident-bot: closing live incident thread. Please file postmortem doc and link back here when ready. :white_check_mark:
